info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Pay Statements Aggregation API
info.description: The Customer Pay Statements Aggregation API facilitates the submission of pay statement data for specific customers, identified by their unique customer IDs. This endpoint allows businesses to aggregate financial information efficiently, ensuring accurate reporting and compliance with financial regulations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and accounting software that require summarized pay statement data for analysis or processing. Use this API to enhance financial transparency and streamline data management processes for your organization.

post.summary: Create a new pay statement for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to generate and submit a new pay statement for a customer identified by their unique ID. It is essential for managing customer records and ensuring accurate financial documentation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new pay statement for the customer identified by CUST-100045. The request should include the necessary payment details and any associated metadata required for processing.
